annotations.title: Schedule C fee breakdown in dollars and bps, with completeness notes

description:
For each large plan year: Schedule C pay by role (recordkeeping, advisory, participant advice, TPA,
investment management, trustee, other) in dollars and basis points of average net assets; every provider
on the Schedule C with names as filed, codes, direct and indirect pay; Schedule H line 2i expenses as a
second view; and a completeness rating with the reasons.

Small plans file no Schedule C: the response still succeeds, with `schedule_c_available: false` and the
plan-paid expenses that small plans do report. Check `get_plan` `availability.fee_years` first to see
which years have a breakdown. Fees are floors: see `meta.coverage_notes`.

Price: $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base (mainnet) with x402 (MCP transport). Without payment the tool returns the payment requirements. Errors and empty results aren't charged.

Same data as GET /fees of the Plan Data API.

plan_year.description: One plan year only. Default: every year.
